provenance.value: pandas.to_timedelta (float branch of pandas.core.arrays.timedeltas.sequence_to_td64ns); also pandas.Timedelta kwargs path

With errors="coerce", float-dtype input (ndarray, Series, Float64 masked input, inf, 2.0**63) raises OutOfBoundsTimedelta instead of coercing to NaT; pd.Timedelta(days=np.inf) raises a bare OverflowError ('cannot convert float infinity to integer').

With errors="coerce", out-of-bounds float elements should become NaT, matching the object-dtype path (pd.to_timedelta([1.5, 1e30], unit="s", errors="coerce") gives [1.5s, NaT]) and pd.to_datetime; pd.Timedelta(days=np.inf) should raise OutOfBoundsTimedelta rather than a bare OverflowError.
